premises.text: Adult calorie-counting weight-loss products are not safe for children
premises.evidence_span: none of these are safe for children. They all involve calorie counting

premises.text: Effective Stanford pediatric obesity care is too expensive and schedule-inaccessible for working parents
premises.evidence_span: But it's $3,500 and has weekday afternoon sessions, so completely not available for working parents

premises.text: Curbo delivers a mobile scalable licensed version of that Stanford approach
premises.evidence_span: we licensed the Stanford program, and we created a mobile, scalable version of their approach

premises.text: Red/yellow/green nutritious-value food tracking with slowly reduced goals replaces calorie counting
premises.evidence_span: we give you goals for how many reds you can eat each day and each week and we reduce those numbers very slowly

premises.text: Weekly coaching via the child's preferred channel budgets social events and reduces household food conflict
premises.evidence_span: gives them very specific feedback on how to budget for a birthday party and how to eat healthier

premises.text: Freemium coaching tiers: free tracker, $35 text, $85 live coaching
premises.evidence_span: We charge $35 a month for text messaging, primarily for teenagers who seem to prefer it. And we charge $85 a month for live coaching

premises.text: Distribution via PR/social, health insurers, hospital systems, and schools
premises.evidence_span: We're talking to hospital systems like Kaiser and Sutter Health who are currently testing our product

domains.name: Access gap for safe pediatric weight loss

value.text: Children lose weight and families eat healthier with less food fighting
value.evidence_span: Parents tell us that their entire families are eating healthier and that they're fighting a lot less about food

causal_links.evidence_span: There were no tools available for me
enable children to eat healthier and to lose weight
help as many kids as we can in our program

notes: Avatar/challenges/therapy screens treated as supporting detail of the tracking program rather than separate premises in this run. User counts and Facebook beta demand excluded per 4.2.
